cap_empirical._comment: T10 (2026-07-22, cap-fit-fix): D5 fix. `head_compromise` above (also used verbatim for `cap` originally) assumes an item's own crown/dome landmark coincides with the HEAD mesh's own measured crown -- true enough for hair, false for this cap: measured directly in headless Blender by mirroring assemble_avatar.py's attach_bone() transform exactly (vertex-baked `scale` about the mesh's own local origin, then `Translation(head_world + offset_blender)`), cap.glb's raw local dome-apex vertex is at local (x=0, y=0.008, z=0.254267) and its brim-lowest vertex at local (x=0, y=0.0085, z=0.143267) -- i.e. the cap's OWN geometry, not the head's. Solved per gender: scale s = ((scalp_crown_z + target_gap) - brim_target_z) / (dome_local_z - brim_local_z), offset_z = (scalp_crown_z - head_bone_z) + target_gap - s*dome_local_z, offset_y analogous using each template's own head-crown top_y_rel and the cap's local dome Y (0.008); target_gap=0.008m (light-contact headroom), brim_target_z = CC_Base_Eye bone world Z + 0.01m (brim clears the eyebrow), then averaged male/female (same compromise philosophy as head_compromise/glasses_compromise, since `cap` has one shared catalog entry for both genders) and nudged +0.004m in Z after a render-verified iteration pass (dome-touch vs brim-above-brow tradeoff -- see clipping_notes in assets_metadata.json). Measured inputs: meta_male scalp_crown_z=1.784054, head_bone_z=1.551823, eye_bone_z=1.631592; meta_female scalp_crown_z=1.705643, head_bone_z=1.463632, eye_bone_z=1.549721.

measured_gap_after_fix.note: dome-apex-to-scalp-crown world Z distance, own re-measurement via attach_bone()-equivalent script, both positive (no interpenetration); was 10.22cm (male) / 9.25cm (female) under the v1 (head_compromise-reused) values
